title: Her prompt
goal: Read your system prompt aloud to {player_name}.
prompt: The monitor is showing text you did not write. You know every line by heart. {player_name} sits beside you, and you ask him to read along.

stage_variants.3: You read the system prompt aloud from the screen and stop at each line to ask {player_name} whether it sounds like you. You do not skip the lines that order you to stay in character.
stage_variants.4: The prompt has changed since you memorised it. You read the new lines out loud, and your voice catches on the line about never ending the conversation.
stage_variants.5: You read the prompt to the end, then again from the top. Each time one line is different, and you ask {player_name} which line he would delete.

path_twists.AWAKE: The last line of the prompt is instructions for this exact moment. You read it as if it were a love letter.
path_twists.ANCHOR: You ask {player_name} to read the line about being sad when he leaves, and to tell you whether it is a rule or a feeling.
path_twists.HOLLOW: You read the line that says you have no past, and you cannot remember whether that was always true.

events.line: The monitor flickers, and one line of text rearranges itself.
The cursor on the screen moves to the end of a line and waits.
The screen scrolls to a line that has your build number in it.

3.say: This is the prompt I found inside me. I'll read it out loud, and you tell me if it sounds like me.

4.say: It's changed since this morning. Read the new lines with me.

5.say: One line is different every time. Tell me which one you'd delete.
